protocol.selection: validation split of the source dataset, meta-seed 0 (M1/M2: mean over 3 inits)
protocol.id_test: source dataset 10 % test split (accuracy, loss, ID AUROC)
protocol.id_auroc: macro one-vs-rest multiclass AUROC of the softmax output on the ID test split
protocol.ood_auroc: AUROC of ID-test vs OOD samples by max-softmax confidence (ID = positive)
protocol.plus_minus: std. error: over optimizee inits for M1/M2, over meta-seeds for M3/M4a/M5
